# FDGA034

> DO specify the `volatile` modifier for fields immediately after the `static` modifier (if specified).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.5 Member Modifiers.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0036
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_preferred_modifier_order = public,private,protected,internal,file,static,extern,volatile,new,virtual,abstract,sealed,override,readonly,unsafe,required,async
```

## From the book

This guideline skips the `readonly` modifier for fields since `volatile` and `readonly` are mutually exclusive modifiers.

```csharp
Right: private static volatile int s_instanceCount;
Wrong: private volatile static int s_instanceCount;
```
